title: security: rbac v2 enforce kms region residency + audit logging hardening
author: Ava Thompson
description: Context: Customers in regulated regions require strict KMS residency guarantees and comprehensive audit trails tied to RBAC v2 policy decisions. This PR implements enforcement and hardening for KMS region pinning in RBAC v2, expands audit logging for key policy decisions, and adds a migration path and feature-flag to roll the change out safely. Motivation: previous RBAC v2 allowed KMS key assignments to be out-of-region in some edge cases which caused a compliance incident for a customer. This change closes those gaps and adds observability so policy administrators can reason about KMS residency violations. Changes: 1) Enforce KMS region residency constraints at policy evaluation time: added evaluation hook in rbac-engine to reject cross-region key bindings when residency policy is enabled. 2) Audit logging: captured structured audit events for all KMS-related policy decisions (decision, reason, matched rule id, affected resource, actor, request_id, prior state). Events are emitted to audit-log service with new event types: KMS_POLICY_EVALUATION, KMS_BINDING_UPDATE, KMS_BINDING_REJECTED. 3) Policy API additions: new policy attributes 'kms_residency' and 'enforce_kms_residency' plus validation in policy schema. 4) Migration: a data migration that scans existing key bindings and emits warnings; an admin CLI command to remediate out-of-region bindings or pin them to customer-managed keys. 5) Feature gate: rollout under feature flag 'rbac_v2_kms_residency_hardening' allowing opt-in followed by a 30d auto-enforce window. 6) Tests and CI: unit and integration tests added for policy evaluation, audit emission, and CLI remediation. 7) Docs: updated security compliance docs and operator migration guide. Checklist: - [x] Implement evaluation hook and schema validation - [x] Emit structured audit events to audit-log service - [x] Add migration tool and admin CLI - [x] Add unit/integration tests - [x] Update docs and Linear items - [x] Feature flag + rollout plan Rollout plan: 1) Enable the feature flag in staging and run the migration scanner for 7 days to collect counts and false positives. 2) Opt-in select customers and run remediation CLI where needed. 3) After validation, flip the flag to enforce in non-prod, monitor for 14 days. 4) Enforce globally with a 30-day notice and automatic enforcement window. Testing: local unit tests, integration tests against a local audit-log sink, end-to-end smoke with Dedicated deployment in staging. Observability: new dashboard (Security > KMS Residency) with metrics: kms_bindings_scanned, kms_bindings_out_of_region, kms_policy_rejections, kms_policy_evaluation_latency. Backwards compatibility: Old policies remain valid but will produce audit warnings until enforcement enabled. Migration notes: The migration scanner tags bindings with remediation recommendations and a safe-run mode that only logs. Security considerations: ensure audit logs are write-once and scrub sensitive key material (only emit key metadata and key arn/ids, never material). Linear/Jira: references included. Related PRs: follow-ups will add automatic remediation suggestions and RBAC UI controls.

review_comments: Diego Martinez (review): Can we ensure evaluation path is async-safe? If policy evaluation is on hot path we might add latency. Suggest adding a fast-path early-exit when enforcement is disabled.
Ava Thompson (reply): Added early-exit and microbenchmarked evaluation; added a unit test for fast-path. See rbac-engine microbenchmark results attached to CI artifacts.
Priya Kapoor (review): Audit payloads look good but please redact or avoid emitting any raw key material. Also please include policy rule id in all events.
Ava Thompson (reply): Confirmed, audit events include policy_rule_id and only key metadata/arn. Updated tests to validate no sensitive fields are emitted.
Lin Zhao (review): Migration could cause large admin ops for customers with many legacy bindings. Can we provide a bulk remediation plan and safe dry-run?
Ava Thompson (reply): Added dry-run option to admin CLI and a remediation plan section in the docs. Also added a 'remediation_suggestions' field in scanner output.
Security team (approval): Approved pending CI green. Ensure KMS integrations do not break private deployment installs.
CI bot: All checks passed on re-run (unit/integration/lint/security-scan).
release_notes: Enforce KMS region residency in RBAC v2 (feature-flag gated). Adds structured audit events for KMS policy evaluations and a migration scanner/CLI to remediate out-of-region bindings. Admins should run the scanner and remediation tool prior to enabling enforcement.
